note: The departments the in-chat home panel must show, in order, with the same ids and labels as the website (assets/app-departments.js). Status is the server's my_departments() answer, not decided here: 'working' opens it, 'soon' shows Coming soon. My films is not a department; it is a link that appears only when featureOn('myFilms') is true for the account. CONNECT builds the panel from this list; the test tests/home-panel-departments.test.mjs fails if the site and this file drift.

my_films.label: My films
my_films.on_means: featureOn('myFilms') is true for the account (its own my_switches() list names myFilms)

status: Which departments WORK for an account and which are Coming soon is the server's my_departments() answer; the panel never decides it. The words below are what a Coming soon card says.

lines.compilations: Say a phrase. Ryagram finds every time it is said in your own footage and strings the moments together. Soon it will turn your clips into songs, too.
lines.geo_intelligence: Ask about places with free public data: who lives near a spot, what is close by, and how counties have changed. Every number says whether it was counted, calculated or estimated.
lines.games: Play with your own data and footage in small games you can share.
lines.animation_studio: Simple cartoons you direct: characters you can pose, with mouths that move to your voice.

data_films_sentence: Questions answered with public data, drawn as a short animated film, with every source shown.
name_note: Ryan's Q601 answer (2026-11-13): the department is called Opportunity Map, shown as Coming soon, with GEO's line. One name on the site and in the panel.
